prompt: I need to break down a user authentication feature into trackable tasks. It needs: database schema, user model, auth middleware, and login/logout endpoints. Each depends on the previous one.
assertions: Uses bd create to create individual beads for each task (schema, model, middleware, endpoints)
Uses bd dep add to create dependency chains between beads
Dependency direction is correct: child depends on parent (bd dep add <child> <parent>)
Creates at least 4 beads matching the specified tasks
Uses --type and --priority flags on bd create commands
Shows the dependency chain flows: schema -> model -> middleware -> endpoints

prompt: What's ready for me to work on? I want to pick up the next available task and start implementing.
assertions: Uses bd ready (not bd list) to find unblocked work
Follows the find-work pattern: check ready, then show task details
Suggests using bd show <bead-id> to inspect the ready task
Does not suggest bd list as the primary way to find work
Mentions or implies claiming work before starting implementation
References the workflow pattern: find ready -> claim -> implement -> close -> sync

prompt: I just finished implementing the database schema task (beads-abc). All tests pass. What do I do next?
assertions: Recommends git commit before bd close (commit first, then close)
Uses bd close beads-abc to mark the task complete
Uses bd sync to synchronize with remote after closing
Checks what got unblocked using bd ready after closing
Follows the correct order: commit -> close -> sync -> check ready
Mentions that closing beads-abc will unblock dependent tasks
